Editors Guild Criticizes MEA's Defense of PM Modi's Unscripted Press Conferences

The Editors Guild has expressed its disappointment with the Ministry of External Affairs' (MEA) defense of Prime Minister Narendra Modi's zero-unscripted press conferences, calling it 'deeply flawed'. The guild argues that these conferences lack transparency and accountability. The MEA's response to the criticism has been met with skepticism by many in the media and civil society. This move is seen as an attempt to silence critics and undermine the freedom of the press.
